g = df.groupby('STATUS')

cols = ['LOAN',
        'MORTDUE',
        'VALUE',
        'YOJ',
        'DEROG',
        'DELINQ',
        'CLAGE',
        'NINQ',
        'CLNO']
dd={}


for col in cols:
    # Filter out NaN values for each group
    all_data = df[col].values[~np.isnan(df[col].values)]
    paid_data = g.get_group('PAID')[col].values[~np.isnan(g.get_group('PAID')[col].values)]
    default_data = g.get_group('DEFAULT')[col].values[~np.isnan(g.get_group('DEFAULT')[col].values)]
    
    if len(all_data) == 0:
        continue
    
    freq, edges = np.histogram(all_data)
    dd[col] = hv.Histogram((edges, freq), label='ALL Loans').redim.label(x=' ')

    if len(paid_data) > 0:
        freq, edges = np.histogram(paid_data, bins=edges)
        dd[col] *= hv.Histogram((edges, freq), label='PAID Loans').redim.label(x=' ')

    if len(default_data) > 0:
        freq, edges = np.histogram(default_data, bins=edges)
        dd[col] *= hv.Histogram((edges, freq), label='DEFAULT Loans' ).redim.label(x=' ')

var = [*dd]
kdims=hv.Dimension(('var', 'Variable'), values=var)
hv.HoloMap(dd, kdims=kdims)
